basis: Paper author blocks and explicit equal-contribution statements; author order alone is not a co-first designation.
shared_institution_rule: Show a distinct institution once when several co-first authors share it.

exceptions.InternVL: Internship marker is not an equal-first-author marker.
exceptions.LF-VILA: Internship marker is not an equal-first-author marker.
exceptions.CoDet: Equal-contribution marks on later authors do not include the unmarked first author.
exceptions.SayPlan: Corresponding-author marker on the first author is distinct from equal-contribution markers on later authors.
exceptions.MoT: Internship and later equal-contribution markers are not a common co-first designation.
exceptions.LLaVA: Liu and Li equal-contribution statement also checked against the official haotian-liu/LLaVA README.
exceptions.SVLTA: MIT and IBM represent the named joint MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab.
exceptions.SafeVLA: PKU and PsiBot represent the named joint lab; ZGC is an additional listed institution.

permission_boundary: Institutional attribution and a downloadable logo do not establish reuse permission. No permission has been obtained by this revision.
provenance: Recovered from manuscript commit d369089; the later housekeeping removal of submission records does not change the figure.
